title: hieracium stenotrichum
intro: Hieracium stenotrichum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the dandelion-like plants of the genus Hieracium. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include wound healing, reducing fever, and treating digestive issues, among others. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium stenotrichum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
